observation: For this bounded exact-text validation task, producer + deterministic QA equaled the producer + independent model auditor in technical outcome. Studio cost an estimated $0.006518 extra; time difference 116 ms; no added measured quality.
operational_rule: Do not spend on routine multiagent reviews solely because more roles exist. Prefer a single producer plus mandatory deterministic gates for similar narrowly scoped, low-risk tasks unless additional audit value is justified. Escalate complex, ambiguous, visual or high-risk cases to appropriate specialists; treat this as a routing hypothesis until replicated.

next_experiment.scope: A real high-impact art/UI task or multi-component functional defect with alternative plausible solutions; preserve active workstream ownership.
criteria: Identical frozen source, evidence, objectives and per-arm ceilings.
Independent blind reviewers evaluate actual render/behavior, not agent prose; identical regression gate.
Record defect classes, quality change, time, cost, interventions and rejected hypotheses.
Require a distinct contribution from specialist and an actual executed change; avoid giving both arms the complete solution in the task.
